# ModernKit v1.5.973 — Mob Spear Thorns Fix

## 🐛 Fixes

- **Thorns now damages mobs wielding spears** — mob spear impacts now apply the
  defender's defensive enchantments in 1.16.5, matching normal melee behavior.
  This allows vanilla Thorns armor to return damage and damage durability for
  spear-wielding Zombies, Husks, Piglins and Zombified Piglins.
